purpose: Models Social Security claiming-age tradeoffs from a claimant's own PIA/FRA statement figures: early-claim reduction and delayed-retirement-credit factors, earnings-test withholding below FRA, lifetime present value at 62/FRA/70/chosen age, and the 62-vs-70 undiscounted break-even age. Root node of the retirement-decumulation-decisions chain. No SSA API, no PII stored. NaN-safe. Zero network.
